rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a connection between things or a relationship between people, groups, or countries.

example.english: These two companies have a good relation.
example.traditional: 呢兩間公司嘅關係幾好。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a family member or relative, rather than for a general relationship.

example.english: He’s a distant relation of mine.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 jyun5 fong2 can1 cik1

rows.note: Use this when relation refers specifically to sexual intercourse or a sexual relationship.

example.english: They used to have a sexual relation.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ji5 cin4 jau5 gwo3 sing3 gwaan1 hai6

rows.note: Use this in formal or written contexts for a narration or account of events.

example.english: This article gives a detailed relation of the whole incident.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章詳細敘述咗成件事。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 coeng4 sai3 zeoi6 seot6 zo2 seng4 gin6 si6
